description: Header file for compile-time string formatting in the fmt library, defining classes, templates, and functions for efficient compile-time format string parsing and formatting.

classes.name: compiled_string
classes.description: A class representing a compile-time string used for fast formatting.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the N-th argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get_arg_index_by_name
methods.description: Gets the index of an argument by its name.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Gets the type of the N-th argument in a type list.

methods.name: make_text
methods.description: Creates a text object from a string view, position, and size.

methods.name: get_arg_checked
methods.description: Checks and retrieves an argument, considering named arguments.

methods.name: parse_tail
methods.description: Parses the tail of a format string.

methods.name: compile_format_string
methods.description: Compiles a format string into a structured representation.
